description: Use this when you have the hold_ids from hold_slot and the booking is confirmed. Turns every hold into a booking in one atomic step: all of them or none, so the slot cannot be lost between reserving and confirming and a group can never be half booked. This is the only way to create a booking. If it is refused, the reply may list other free times: offer one and call hold_slot on it, since none of them is reserved for you.
